newsitem.title: USA: RIGCO rig gets Shell Offshore contract.
newsitem.headline: RIGCO rig gets Shell Offshore contract.

text.p: RIGCO North America LLC said Wednesday the Royal Dutch/Shell Group's Shell Offshore Inc has agreed to use the semisubmersible drilling unit Bill Shoemaker for one year after its current deployment.

RIGCO, a DeepTech International Inc subsidiary, said the Bill Shoemaker is currently en route to offshore Newfoundland under contract to Amoco Corp's Amco Canada Petroleum Co Ltd for a two well drilling program in the Grand Banks area following completion of an upgrade and winterization program that will allow the rig to work in environmentally harsh environments.
The arrival of the Bill Shoemaker in the Grand Banks area will mark the first operations by a semisubmersible drilling unit in that area since the early 1990's, RIGCO pointed out.
In addition, while the drilling rig is in the Grand Banks area, RIGCO affiliate Tatham Offshore Inc has an option to drill another well in the area upon completion of the Amoco contract.

Shell will have the unit remobilized to the Gulf of Mexico upon completion of the contractual commitments for the rig in eastern Canada. Shell has an option to extend the one-year contract for an additional six-month period at mutually agreed rates, RIGCO said.
The Bill Shoemaker is owned by RIGCO and operated under a management agreement by the Sedco Forex Division of Schlumberger Ltd.
RIGCO owner DeepTech owns 37 percent of Tatham Offshore.
